info.name: JusticeFlow API — Frontend (Client Calls)
info.description:
Postman collection mirroring **exactly** the API calls made by the JusticeFlow React frontend (`client/src/api/*`).

Use it to test the backend from the frontend's point of view — same base URL config (`VITE_API_URL`), same paths, same payloads the UI sends.

## Structure (mirrors client/src/api)
| Frontend module | Folder in this collection |
|---|---|
| auth.api.ts | Auth |
| organization.api.ts / court.api.ts (orgs) | Organizations |
| fir.api.ts | FIR |
| case.api.ts | Cases |
| investigation.api.ts | Investigation |
| document.api.ts | Documents |
| court.api.ts | Court |
| bail.api.ts | Bail |
| timeline.api.ts (audit) | Audit Logs |
| documentRequests.api.ts | Document Requests |
| timeline.api.ts | Timeline |
| search.api.ts | Search |
| closureReport.api.ts | Closure Report |
| caseReopen.api.ts | Case Reopen |
| ai.api.ts | AI Features |
| aiEnhanced.api.ts | AI Enhanced |

## Setup
1. Server: `cd server && npm run dev` → `http://localhost:5000` (matches `VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api`)
2. Seed demo data: `npm run db:seed`
3. Run **Auth → Login (Officer)** — token auto-saves to `{{token}}` (same as the app storing it in localStorage).

## Demo Accounts
| Role | Email | Password |
|---|---|---|
| POLICE | officer1@police.gov | password123 |
| SHO | sho.central@police.gov | password123 |

| JUDGE | judge@court.gov | password123 |

exec: console.log('token saved (same as localStorage.setItem in the app)');

request.description: `POST /auth/login` — the exact call from `authApi.login`. App saves token to localStorage; here it's saved to `{{token}}`.
Switch role by editing email: sho.central@police.gov (SHO), clerk@court.gov (COURT_CLERK), judge@court.gov (JUDGE). Password: password123.
`GET /police-stations` — used on login pages and SHO dashboards. Save a station id to `{{stationId}}`.
`GET /courts` — used by SHO submit-to-court form. Save a court id to `{{courtId}}`.
`GET /officers` — `organizationApi.getOfficers`, SHO only. Save an officer id to `{{officerId}}` for assignment.
`POST /firs` — `firApi.createFIR`: multipart with incidentDate + sectionsApplied (required) and optional file. Auto-creates the linked Case; saves `firId` and `caseId`.
`GET /cases/all?page&limit` — `caseApi.getAllCases` / `caseApi.getCases` (SHO, COURT_CLERK, JUDGE). Saves first case id to `{{caseId}}`.
`POST /cases/:caseId/evidence` — `investigationApi.createEvidence`: multipart with category + description (+ optional collectedDate, collectedFrom, file).

formdata.value: Saw accused near scene at 9 PM

request.description: `POST /cases/:caseId/witnesses` — `investigationApi.createWitness`: multipart with name + statement (+ contact, address, statementFile).
`POST /cases/:caseId/documents` — `documentApi.createDocument`: multipart with documentType + contentJson (stringified JSON) + optional file field named `document`.

body.raw:
{
  "applicantName": "Advocate S. Rao",
  "applicantRelation": "Counsel for accused",
  "grounds": "Accused is resident of the city, no flight risk",
  "accusedId": "{{accusedId}}",
  "bailType": "POLICE",
  "orderDocumentUrl": ""
}

request.description: `POST /cases/:caseId/bail-applications` — `bailApi.createBailRecord`. Route validators: applicantName, applicantRelation, grounds. Service: accusedId (must belong to case), bailType (POLICE | ANTICIPATORY | COURT), orderDocumentUrl.
`POST /document-requests` — POLICE. documentType: ARREST_WARRANT | SEARCH_WARRANT | REMAND_ORDER | CHARGE_SHEET_COPY | OTHER. Saves `requestId`.
`POST /document-requests/:id/issue` — court uploads the signed PDF: file required, remarks optional.
`POST /cases/:caseId/closure-report` — generates the PDF, returns { reportUrl }. No body.
`POST /ai/case-readiness` — `aiApi.checkCaseReadiness` (SHO). Server recomputes counts from the DB; extra fields ignored.
`GET /ai/enhanced/section-details/:id?code_type` — replace `1` with a real section id.
